name: hermes-router
description: Control panel for hermes-router — monitor provider health and manage your multi-provider AI router from VS Code.

hermesRouter.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the running hermes-router — the host and port only, e.g. http://localhost:8319 (a trailing /v1 is ignored). Use your Space URL for a remote router; CLI controls are disabled when remote.

hermesRouter.apiKey.description: Application key for chat/inference (PROXY_API_KEYS or a key created in Connect). Existing settings remain compatible. Owner status and remote restart use the optional Set Administrator Credential command, stored in VS Code SecretStorage.

hermesRouter.hrPath.description: Path to the `hr` CLI (used for local control actions).

hermesRouter.contextWindow.description: 0 follows the dashboard context length (40,192 tokens when the router is on Auto or does not advertise a window). A positive value requests a larger total context, including output. The dashboard minimum always applies. The effective window must exceed maxOutputTokens.

hermesRouter.maxOutputTokens.description: Reply token budget reserved within the effective context window from the dashboard or contextWindow. Must be smaller than that window. Provider output caps still apply.

hermesRouter.dockerContainer.description: Name (or ID) of the Docker container running hermes-router. When set, control actions run via `docker exec <container> hr …` and Restart runs `docker restart <container>`. Requires the `:cli` image (e.g. shafiq735/hermes-router:cli) with a mounted volume so changes persist. Leave blank for a non-Docker local install.

hermesRouter.refreshSeconds.description: How often to refresh the dashboard, status bar and router context setting (seconds).
